privacyIntro: At Mythrion, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacyDataUse: We collect only the information necessary to create and manage your account, provide the service, and process payments.
privacySecurity: Your account information is protected using industry-standard security measures, and we limit access to trusted personnel.
privacyRetention: We retain your information only as long as needed to operate the service, comply with legal obligations, and support your account.
privacyContact: If you have questions about this policy, contact support at portal@mythrion.com.
termsIntro: By using Mythrion, you agree to these terms, which govern access, subscriptions, and acceptable behavior.
termsSubscription: Subscription cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing period. You will retain access for the remainder of your paid term and will not be charged again.
termsUserConduct: You agree not to misuse the service, infringe on others' rights, or engage in abusive behavior.
termsTermination: Mythrion may suspend or terminate accounts for violation of these terms or for activity that harms the platform.
termsContact: For questions about these terms, please contact support at portal@mythrion.com.
cancelTermsIntro: These terms govern the cancellation of your Mythrion Premium subscription. By cancelling, you agree to the conditions below.
cancelTermsEffect: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Once your request is processed, no further renewals will be scheduled.
cancelTermsAccess: You will retain full access to Mythrion Premium until the end of your paid billing period, even after requesting cancellation.
cancelTermsCharges: You will not be charged again after cancelling. As you keep access for the remainder of an already-paid period, no refund is issued for that period.
cancelTermsHowToCancel: You can cancel at any time from the Subscription page in your dashboard. To submit the cancellation, you must read these terms and check the acceptance box.
cancelTermsAfterCancellation: When your subscription ends, your account returns to the free tier. Your campaigns and character sheets remain available, and features that require a paid plan become limited.
cancelTermsContact: For questions about these terms, please contact support at portal@mythrion.com.
